review_notes: Republica dates the Tinsaura landslide to Wednesday morning Aug 8; Mandandeupur-10 (not Bhumlu) and one toddler fatality. Same incident is also represented in queue V11R-113; identity should be reconciled separately.

Oct 22 photo shows the Turture Badigad landslide dam, not its occurrence date. Contemporary Republica Sept 15 report says massive Turture failure began previous night, Sept 14. Corroboration: https://myrepublica.nagariknetwork.com/news/baglung-burtibang-butwal-road-to-be-be-obstructed-for-a-week/
Aug 31 morning slide at Tophe Khola blocked Narayangadh-Muglin road in Chitwan; Kathmandu appears only as unrelated publisher address.
Ujyaalo specifically locates the morning road-blocking slide at Rakse, Kaligandaki-2; Satyawati-6 is a separate flood/mud blockage.
Nepal Press places buried house at Khewang, Sirijangha; confirms two women (Tulasa and Yashoda) dead. Sidingba is only a school-closure reference.
June 13 article explicitly says the Tarebhir slope failed that morning around 10:00 and large boulders rolled toward homes; April 25 is earthquake date.
Ujyaalo identifies slope failure at Damdare Khola, Kushma-4, Parbat, blocking Kushma-Baglung road; Baglung is route/destination.
Nepal Press specifies Tansen-8 Gaudepul, Palpa, where slide washed away about 50 m of Siddhartha Highway; Rupandehi is dateline.
Himalayan Times states seven relatives died in the Aug 13 morning landslide at Bakaiya-10, Makwanpur; Kathmandu is publication dateline.
Himalayan Times June 14 update dates Kushma-3 Durlung Dhakalbari slide to 8 pm Saturday June 13; eight recovered fatalities in update.
Sept 25 reopening article says large dry Tuin Khola failure occurred Tuesday afternoon Sep 23 and blocked Chitwan highway; earlier Friday slide is separate.

Jhyaple Khola is at Dhunibesi-9 Dhading, not Kathmandu. Sept 30 Kathmandu Post describes vehicles buried Friday night Sep 27; Sept 29 recovery reports 35 bodies. Corroboration: https://kathmandupost.com/province-no-5/2024/09/30/dreams-shattered-in-jhyaplekhola-landslide Same incident is also represented in queue V11R-046; identity should be reconciled separately.

Jhyaple Khola Dhading incident buried vehicles Friday night Sep 27 (Kathmandu Post Sept 30); article records 14 bodies Saturday and 21 Sunday, 35 cumulative rather than five newly found. Corroboration: https://kathmandupost.com/province-no-5/2024/09/30/dreams-shattered-in-jhyaplekhola-landslide Same incident is also represented in queue V11R-043; identity should be reconciled separately.
Nagarik dates Seti Dobhan slide to Thursday evening Aug 26; blockage is on Narayangadh-Muglin route in Chitwan, reopened Friday.

Simaltal slide in Chitwan metropolitan ward 29 occurred July 12; July 17 task-force report records 17 recovered bodies, not confirmed fate of others. Same incident is also represented in queue V11R-121; identity should be reconciled separately.

Sept 9 mudslide near Nagdhunga tunnel entrance blocked highway; contemporaneous reporting places Sisne Khola/tunnel-entrance site in Dhunibesi-9, Dhading. Corroboration: https://www.kathmandupati.com/news/pahiro-69/336440/
Ujyaalo specifically dates fresh 07:00 Mugling-Narayangadh road slide to Sept 29 in Chitwan; article gives no exact municipality. Bhotkhola and Makalu are separate undated blockages.

Oct 28 reports concern search stoppage, not failure date. Contemporary Radio Nepal Oct 19 report places Thalara-4 Dikla slide Tuesday morning Oct 19; four bodies recovered, 19 others missing. Corroboration: https://radionepalonline.com/en/2021/10/19/215712.html
OnlineKhabar reports new Khahare Khola dry slide near Muglin at 15:00 July 28 on the Chitwan road; Kathmandu is dateline, earlier cleared slide a separate occurrence.
Aug 2 Himalayan Times reports Saturday recovery from Thursday July 30 Bhadaure Tamagi landslide; six deaths there, not two Chitwan traffic fatalities or districtwide 35.

Archived Nagarik headline confirms two killed by Siddhababa van slide; contemporary Kathmandu Post June 17 article confirms same-day incident and the two doctor fatalities. Corroboration: https://kathmandupost.com/miscellaneous/2015/06/17/two-doctors-killed-in-palpa-landslide
Nagarik and Setopati date Three-Kilo Ichchhyakamana-5 slide to Thursday June 29 around 13:00; June 30 was debris-clearance/reopening forecast.

OnlineKhabar Til village account specifies the failure at ~23:00 Jestha 1 in Namkha-6; Jestha 1 BS 2082 corresponds to May 15 2025, not Mar 2026 page metadata. Corroboration: https://nepalipatro.com.np/calendar/bs/2082-02-01/panchanga

June 30 report plus contemporaneous RSS/other news states a Gagane Khola slide occurred early Monday after Sunday-night rain, blocking Karnali Highway. Corroboration: https://thehimalayantimes.com/nepal/landslide-blocks-karnali-highway-in-kalikot
Republica says slide on Sunday Aug 14 destroyed power poles on Tarukaghat line in Nuwakot Taruka; Dhading was affected electricity-service area.
Sunday July 1 ~23:00 landslide near Siddhababa Temple blocked Butwal-Tansen highway in Palpa; Syangja only a stranded travelers’ destination.

Aug 20 Setopati contemporaneously describes moving bus struck by new mudslide at Ruru Kshetra-1 Ratamata with police still trying to extract bus; Monday-night rain is antecedent. Corroboration: https://www.setopati.com/social/337138
Setopati states same-morning July 13 slide blocked Karnali corridor at Lafa Bazaar, Pachaljharana-8, Kalikot; Humla obstruction was separate flood-damaged bridge.
Two July 1 Nepali reports name Prince BK and father Ramesh and put Bheri landslide Monday morning (~05:30); one other report says Sunday night, but more specific police-timed accounts support July 1.

OnlineKhabar says Sept 9 slide 300 m below Nagdhunga checkpoint by temple; contemporaneous accounts specifically locate this tunnel-entrance/Sisne Khola slide in Dhunibesi-9, Dhading. Corroboration: https://www.kathmandupati.com/news/pahiro-69/336440/
Ujyaalo dates Feb 28 landslide at Kimtadi, Mahakali-5, Darchula that blocked Mahakali Highway; Eastern Rukum closure was caused by snow.

Setopati dates storm Tuesday night but not after-midnight failure; the separately included Republica Tinsaura report identifies same toddler Dipak Tamang and explicitly says Wednesday Aug 8 morning. Same incident is also represented in queue V11R-002; identity should be reconciled separately.

OnlineKhabar states morning July 12 Simaltal slide swept two buses; four bodies had been recovered as of July 14 but 58 still missing. Same incident is also represented in queue V11R-050; identity should be reconciled separately.
Ujyaalo locates previous-night Kali Gandaki-blocking slide on Jaljala-3 bank in Parbat; resulting river flood damaged Myagdi Kalipul, which is not failure district.
